title: Real Patient, Real Results: When "Standard Treatment" Isn't Enough
excerpt: A 58-year-old woman came to us with type 2 diabetes, severe insulin resistance, and sugars that wouldn't budge on a four-drug regimen. Here's what changed when we treated insulin resistance, weight, and blood pressure as one connected problem.

title: Why I Now Push Every Suitable GDM Patient Toward CGM
excerpt: A pattern from my own practice managing Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) has made me a firm believer in continuous glucose monitoring during pregnancy — here's the clinical reasoning, the evidence, and where it's still an evolving field.
